title: Howard Stern's Back: Taylor Swift Wedding, Ronnie's Summer & More
summary: Check out the full episode on the SiriusXM app.
body_markdown:
[Howard Stern](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/howard-stern) and Robin Quivers returned live on Monday, September 14 and discussed his HBO deal, the tabloids,[Taylor Swift](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/taylor-swift) ’s wedding, Ronnie’s sexy summer, summer 2026 obits, John Mayer and his[recent concert at Stephen Talkhouse](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/john-mayer-siriusxm-concert-stephen-talkhouse) , and more.

### Howard Stern on SiriusXM


[Howard Stern](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/howard-stern) , best known for his deep, wide-ranging long-form discussions with legendary figures across music, comedy, entertainment and beyond, will be taking a rare seat in the guest chair. Howard’s legendary interview, comedy and entertainment radio show, “The Howard Stern Show,” airs exclusively on SiriusXM, where Howard has produced two channels of new and classic shows since 2006.


Additionally, this Thursday, September 17, Howard’s show arrives on HBO Max.
